text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae and Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan Sensei! Teach us how to get
more
Umazings!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, you don't have to call me
that! ♪
But okay, I can tell you both a
thing or two.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look for interesting things that people
can't stop
looking at!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Put yourselves in the shoes of your fans,
and think
of things that they'll want to
keep their eyes on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So for an Umadol... That could be
practice
videos! Maybe they'd want to
see my prep for the
next concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If they see how hard I'm working every
day, they'll
end up wanting to see me
live even more!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What would fans of a Tomakomai local
idol want
to see...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Maybe the town ramen shop rankings?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll throw in my own bowl reports with
the
rankings. That should keep people
coming back!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
People will flock to Tomakomai from all
over just
to try the local delicacies, and
to think that it
might all be thanks to
ramen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah, I think it'd be hard to keep eyes
off of
that, so sounds good! ☆ Surprising
and new ideas
are also a driving force
behind Umazings! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If that sounds good, then off I go!
